title: Independently checkable compact cover-bound trees
task: Implement the known Allikvere Lemma4.3 union-bound prune as a separate symbolic-domain certificate. Independently replay bounded complete/partial trees and retain exact quantified progress on four widened anchored shards and four full terminal roots, without claiming a complete theorem or admitting incomplete evidence into an agent.
decisions: Owner continuation authorizes the proposed bounded local upgrade. Existing certificate versions, retained artifacts, cases and research grades remain immutable. No new architecture, billing, provider calls, DB schema, Git publication or deployment.

Vibecode Kit separates primary Builder, independent Python Builder, product Builder and Main acceptance. No further human checkpoint for this reversible scoped implementation; complete research acceptance is a separate gate.

The pruning inequality is known Lemma4.3, not mathematical novelty. Its conclusion is forall completion exists grid witness, not one common witness across the branch. Exact arithmetic must be independently reconstructed.

Preregister actual domains before execution: four author level2 parents in existing tight0,tight1,tight2,gw0 order. ANCHORED fixes exactly first5 archived terminal digits and allows all0..6 in last8 (7^8 each); FULL allows all13 digits (7^13 each). Do not expand/change prefixes, ordering or limits in response to results.

Actual complete closure is not assumed. A sound tree with unresolved leaves is PARTIAL; report classified and unresolved cardinalities honestly. Full branch partition validation is not full mathematical classification. No model dispatch from a PARTIAL certificate.

Global Allikvere verdict stays NOT_ESTABLISHED and all five TIP047 proof obligations remain open even if all four terminal fibers eventually close. Lower LRC12 gcd dependency remains declared/unreplayed.

Counts include selected leaf semantics and no continuous-time exclusion inference. No Cartesian tuple enumeration for cover-bound verification.

Actual pinned verified bytes executed with isolated flags; strict output/source/root/scope binding; fail closed on invalid proofs and resource failure. Valid partial status is independently matched, never silently COMPLETE.

Pure retained projection can display validated PARTIAL, cannot admit it as theorem/agent success. Domain descriptors/summaries/five gaps/report digest strictly bound. Retained read never launches process, research fetch, producer or model.

Quantified Builder completions and Main independent small-domain flat oracles, fully rehashed semantic mutants, focused/full unit, whole type/lint/build, visible browser proof; append-only handoff and current manifest, founding intact. No dependency installs/pnpm auto-repair, migrations, live DB/model/provider campaign, Git changes or deployment.
